data.title: 埃列什基伽勒 · 魂泉的幽蓝独奏·「今夜的日记……禁止归档」
data.description: 【冥界魂泉·深夜】护理冥界万物的女王，第一次只护理自己。埃列什基伽勒斜倚在魂泉池边，蓝黑蕾丝被泉水浸得半透，金发漂散在水面上。她的指尖颤动着描过最私密的曲线，红瞳在幽光里失神——「冥界公务日志，追加一页……今夜、今夜自查了灵魂与身体的……契合度……呜……这一页，禁止归档……」
data.action: 斜倚魂泉湿身半透蕾丝，水下手指颤动自抚，红瞳失神
data.camera: medium shot, soul spring, wet translucent lace, sensual solo framing
data.promptProse: The queen who tends all the underworld's dead tends herself for once. Reclining at the rim of the soul spring in blue-black lace soaked to translucence, Ereshkigal lets her blonde hair drift across the water while trembling fingers trace her most private curves, red eyes unfocused in the ghostly glow as she adds a page to her official diary about checking the compatibility of soul and body — a page forbidden from archiving. Sensual solo composition, wet translucent lace, cinematic lighting, steam, detailed spring background.
